description: This file declares the interface and class definitions for the MediaKeysServerInternal component, including factory creation, session management, and decryption functionalities within the Rialto media server. It provides class declarations, method signatures, and internal data structures related to media key sessions and DRM handling.

classes.name: MediaKeysServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaKeys and IMediaKeysServerInternal based on key system.

classes.name: MediaKeysServerInternal
classes.description: Implements the IMediaKeysServerInternal interface, managing media key sessions, DRM operations, and decryption processes.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates a new IMediaKeys instance for the specified key system.

methods.name: createMediaKeysServerInternal
methods.description: Creates a new IMediaKeysServerInternal instance for the specified key system.

methods.name: MediaKeysServerInternal
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MediaKeysServerInternal with key system and factory dependencies.

methods.name: ~MediaKeysServerInternal
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for a given session.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a session contains a specific key.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session of a given type.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request for a session.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with license response data.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets DRM header data for a session.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Closes an active key session.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Removes a key session.

methods.name: deleteDrmStore
methods.description: Deletes the DRM store.

methods.name: deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Gets the LDL sessions limit.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code for a session.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Gets the current DRM time.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of encrypted media data.

methods.name: hasSession
methods.description: Checks if a session exists.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if the key system is PlayReady.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Increments the usage counter for a session.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Decrements the usage counter for a session.
